issue.title: Projects e2e all-closed standalone Closed peek fails on master: sync writes stored callout so no standalone anchor paints
issue.description:
## CI failure

Pre-existing real-Obsidian failure, reproduced identically with and without the embedded-catalog-cards change.

`scripts/obsidian-projects-ui-e2e.cjs` times out waiting for `value.standalone?.some((card) => /0 open/.test(...))` on `all-closed.md` in Reading view ("all-closed host Closed peek" / `closed-peek-default`). The probe shows the stored `[!projects]` callout card fully painted (3 closed rows, header, tally) and zero standalone chrome.

Root cause: `bob projects sync` writes a `> [!projects]` callout at the end of the host's `## Projects` section, so every Reading render of `all-closed.md` either contains a callout region (full-note and Projects-section renders) or misses the anchor line (detached block renders). `paintProjectsCatalogReading` therefore never paints the standalone anchor + Closed peek the check expects. The check's expectation predates current sync placement (`Placement::AfterSectionThenFirstH2` in `src/native/host_catalog/region.rs`).

Remediation needs a product decision: either (a) change the e2e to expect the callout card with its Closed group for all-closed hosts, or (b) change sync placement/paint so all-closed hosts keep a standalone anchor. The embedded-catalog-cards work deliberately does not touch this path; its new embeds checks run after this check and were verified green separately (see bead evidence: 6/6 embeds checks pass, screenshots inspected).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Embedded catalog cards implementation, workspace bob-cli_15. Ran scripts/obsidian-projects-ui-e2e.cjs twice in real Obsidian (Xvfb): once on my tree and once on the pristine master tree (changes stashed, rebuilt). Both runs pass the same 27 checks and time out at the same waitFor ("all-closed host Closed peek"): all-closed.md carries a stored `[!projects]` callout that `bob projects sync` writes at the end of its `## Projects` section, so no section render can paint a standalone anchor (every candidate section text either contains the callout region or misses the anchor line). Deterministic across two full runs on different trees; not load-related.

issue.creation_reason: Pre-existing real-Obsidian e2e failure blocking the Projects walkthrough gate; reproduced identically on pristine master, unrelated to the embedded-catalog-cards change.
